items.title: PTC (PTC) Launches Onshape Labs To Bring AI Into Product Development
items.summary: PTC (NasdaqGS:PTC) has launched Onshape Labs within its cloud-native CAD and PDM platform. The initiative introduces an early-access program for customers to test AI-driven tools inside live product development workflows. Initial capabilities include AI Quick Render, automation agents, and AI-powered drawing validation. PTC plans a broader rollout of Onshape Labs features to its customer base soon. items.title: What Could Push ADSK Stock Higher From Here?
items.summary: Five years ago, Autodesk spent about $1.8 billion on a string of construction acquisitions. That bet has now compounded into a business generating almost $600 million in annual revenue. This segment is still growing north of 20%, a rate faster than the company average.
